text:
mike: Quick heads-up — thanks to everyone who joined today’s exec roundtable. Post-call summary + links below.

maya: Agenda recap: 1) Q2 roadmap highlights (product + infra) 2) Dedicated SLA update 3) Data retention policy change brief 4) Recent minor incident summary 5) Open Q&A. Kept it tight at 45m.

lina_ops: Recording + slides uploaded: https://redwood-internal/recordings/1865436789 and https://redwood-internal/slides/roundtable-apr2026.pdf :thumbsup:

mike: TL;DR takeaways: - We’re prioritizing lower p99 latency for chat workloads on Dedicated. - Small policy tweak on logs retention (details below). - Incident on 4/12 was contained; no customer data exposure.

jordan_prod: Launch callout: we’re rolling the beta of token-caching feature to Dedicated next week (canary -> global over 3 days). PMs will get rollout windows in calendar.

maya: Dedicated SLA change: adding a latency SLO for p95 for reserved pools. This is an opt-in change for existing customers (will not auto-apply). Ops team will publish migration docs by EOD Friday.

samir_sre: Incident summary (4/12 03:10 UTC) — model-serving pool had a regression after a kernel scheduler tweak; 15m of elevated error rates, automatic fallback worked as designed. Root cause: kernel selection heuristic mis-classified sequence-length distribution. Patch deployed and verified. Postmortem scheduled for Tue.

elena_research: Policy note: data retention for request logs reduced from 120 -> 60 days for non-enterprise accounts to reduce risk and storage cost. Enterprise customers with compliance needs unaffected. Docs + FAQ: https://redwood-internal/docs/data-retention-change

lina_ops: Actions tracked: - @maya to publish migration guide (due Fri) - @samir_sre to post incident postmortem (due Tue) - @jordan_prod to share beta rollout calendar (due Mon) - @elena_research to update docs and FAQ (done)

ops-bot: Meeting recording processed and captions available (auto-caption quality: medium). Link: https://redwood-internal/cc/1865436789.vtt

mike: If you had questions during the call and didn’t get to ask, please drop them here or use the Q form: https://forms.gle/redwood-allhands-q. We’ll compile answers into a short FAQ.

jordan_prod: FYI — if your team relies on longer retention, ping product and legal so we don’t break any contracts.

lina_ops: Thanks all — will follow up with the action grid and calendar invites for the postmortem + migration office hours. :calendar: 

maya: Appreciated — great discussion. Short survey after the thread to improve format for next time.

mike: End of thread — cheers and thanks to folks who prepared slides and the infra patch crew. :tada:
